$comment: A post's stored fields, by the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026 (posts, topics and people). A post is stored as sections (layout) on both platforms; a section that is prose alone draws as the post's prose, and every other section as a band (markup/post.json, sections in a post). Video is in the ruled starting list but has no section yet (ID-3951); it joins layout's sections when it exists. Tables are parked for their own PRD. The view's document (fixtures/post) is these fields as the post view receives them: its date derived from publishedAt in the site's time zone, its category from primaryTopic, its topics and author resolved, the topics drawn with the primary topic first and the rest A to Z by title, not in the order they were picked (the founder's ruling of 19/11/2026), its layout's sections as stored.
label: Post

nextjs.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

wordpress.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author
fields.description: Optional. Credit the native user independently of the team tick. Removing the tick never removes the credit.

wordpress.owes: the taxonomy box labelled Topics, with no parent control

fields.name: primaryTopic
fields.label: Primary topic
fields.description: Optional. One of the post's topics, shown above its title.

wordpress.owes: the field, of the theme's own beside the Topics box: WordPress has no primary category

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences, shown on cards wherever the item is listed.

nextjs.owes: summary in place of excerpt; a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the excerpt's a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: publishedAt
fields.label: Published
fields.description: The moment the post is published. Its date is shown in the site's time zone.

nextjs.owes: the field, back-filled from createdAt, and ordering posts by it in place of createdAt

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Body
fields.description: The post, section by section. A single image is a gallery of one.

wordpress.owes: the section builder on posts, stored as layout, in place of the classic editor

dropped.note: Tags are drawn from topics; the Tags box is removed from posts.

display.$comment: Derived from Salt for Next.js's READ_CARD and Salt for WordPress's inc/sections/blog-teaser.php, with the rc.7 names.

href.note: The post's own page. Routing is each platform's own.

date.note: The date in the site's time zone, as YYYY-MM-DD. Salt for Next.js reads createdAt today.

tags.note: When the section shows tags. Each topic's title; Uncategorised is never drawn.
